name: ahto
description: AHTO: test-matrix-driven integration testing across hardware, software, and services.

scripts.check:surface: npm pack --dry-run --json > .ahto-pack-dry-run.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.ahto-pack-dry-run.json','utf8')); const files=(data[0]&&data[0].files||[]).map(f=>f.path); const must=['SKILL.md','README.md','LICENSE','docs/architecture.md','docs/packaged-workflow.md','core/emit_defect_record.mjs','core/emit_run_summary.mjs','adapters/notion/README.md','adapters/cdp/README.md','adapters/hardware-sync/README.md','examples/iot-dashboard/README.md','examples/iot-dashboard/test-matrix.json']; const forbidden=['references/','scripts/','output/']; must.forEach(p=>{ if(!files.includes(p)) throw new Error('missing packaged path: '+p); }); forbidden.forEach(prefix=>{ if(files.some(f=>f===prefix || f.startsWith(prefix))) throw new Error('forbidden packaged path: '+prefix); }); console.log('surface-ok')" && rm -f .ahto-pack-dry-run.json
scripts.check: npm run check:notion-adapter && npm run check:cdp-adapter && npm run check:example-json && npm run check:surface
scripts.check:private-residue: echo 'Run the residue audit described in the packaging handoff before release.'
